sources.snippet: Tokenization is one of the most important processes in AI - yet many would like to kill it 💀What's tokenization? The neural networks inside LLMs actually only process numbers, not text: tokenization is the process that makes text readable for them, by converting sentences into lists of numbers. ️ For instance, "This is tokenization" would be split into "This | is | token | ization", then ...
